mcqs.q: Which is the largest national park in India by geographic area, world-famous for its high concentration of wild snow leopards?
mcqs.exp: Hemis National Park in Ladakh spans over 4,400 sq km and is India's largest designated national park.

mcqs.q: Which mountain pass in Ladakh, constructed by BRO at 19,024 feet, is officially recognized by Guinness World Records as the world's highest motorable pass?
mcqs.exp: Umling La pass in Eastern Ladakh was constructed by Border Roads Organisation (BRO) under Project Himank.

subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Ladakh.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Leh. Ladakh covers a geographic area of 59,146 sq km across 2 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Indus (Sindhu), Zanskar, Shyok, Nubra, Galwan.

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: India's highest cold desert plateau, created as a Union Territory without legislature on 31 October 2019. Home to Pangong Tso lake, Hemis National Park, Umling La (world's highest motorable pass, 19,024 ft), and Siachen Glacier.

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Ladakh.

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Ladakh was formally instituted on 31 October 2019. Official language(s): Ladakhi, Tibetan, Hindi, English.

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Chham (Sacred Mask Dance), Jabro, Shondol (Royal dance).

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Hemis Festival, Losar, Ladakh Festival, Dosmoche.

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of Ladakh.

facts.title: Lieutenant Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Lieutenant Governor is Brig. (Dr.) B. D. Mishra.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh.

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Snow leopard | State Bird: Black-necked crane | State Flower: Nil | State Tree: Juniper.

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in Ladakh.

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Geothermal energy (Puga Valley), Borax, Sulphur.

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: Ladakh plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in Ladakh.

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Leh Palace, Thiksey Monastery, Hemis Gompa, Shanti Stupa, Diskit Monastery (Nubra).

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: Hemis National Park (India's largest national park and global snow leopard capital).

subtopics.name: State Schemes & Awards
subtopics.summary: Prominent welfare schemes, civic initiatives, and state honors of Ladakh.

facts.title: Key State Welfare Schemes
facts.content: Notable welfare initiatives and government programs: Carbon-Neutral Ladakh Initiative, Mission Organic Development Initiative (M.O.D.I.).
